tasks.title: Models, policy, result budget, worktree lock and shared toolkit base
tasks.parallelism_notes: Foundation (M1). Fixes package layout, raw-argument validation in _pre_execute, ToolResult serialization, byte budget and flock-based WorktreeLock. Every other toolkit task imports from it, so it must land first.

tasks.title: LocalGitToolkit — subprocess runner, repository discovery, git_recent, git_fetch, git_preflight
tasks.parallelism_notes: M2 first half. Owns git.py and tests/tool_optimizations/conftest.py. Shares no files with TASK-3082 (reader.py), TASK-3084 (patches.py), TASK-3087 (core mcp) or TASK-3088 (hooks.py); can run in its own worktree after TASK-3079.

tasks.title: LocalGitToolkit — isolated-index staging (git_prepare_files), fast-forward pull and non-force push
tasks.parallelism_notes: Extends git.py and test_git.py created by TASK-3080; same files, must be sequential with it.

tasks.title: BoundedSourceToolkit — streaming source_info / source_read with hashes and continuation
tasks.parallelism_notes: M3. Owns reader.py and test_reader.py only; independent of the Git tasks. Its pure helpers (read_line_range, sha256_stream, stat_regular) are consumed by TASK-3083/3085/3086.

tasks.title: Delegation contracts — TASK-file packet parser, labelled code blocks, scope/freshness validation
tasks.parallelism_notes: M4. Owns contracts.py, tests/fixtures.py, test_contracts.py. Can run alongside TASK-3084 (patches.py) — no shared files. Fixes the packet grammar reused by TASK-3085/3090.

tasks.title: Unified-diff parser/validator, staging-area application and artifact store
tasks.parallelism_notes: M5 (patches.py). Pure stdlib module; owns patches.py and test_patches.py. Independent of TASK-3080/3082/3083.

tasks.title: TargetedWriterToolkit — constructor no-fallback guard and writer_generate via AbstractClient
tasks.parallelism_notes: M5 (writer.py, generate half). Imports contracts.py and patches.py; must follow both.

tasks.title: writer_apply — hash-gated, precondition-checked, journaled application with rollback and recovery
tasks.parallelism_notes: M5 (writer.py, apply half). Edits writer.py and models.py (adds PatchManifest.task_path); composes LocalGitToolkit from TASK-3080/3081 for staged-target checks and the lock path.

tasks.title: MCP toolkit configuration — ToolkitSection.llm_kwargs pass-through and example config
tasks.parallelism_notes: M6. Touches only core parrot/mcp/toolkit_config.py, toolkit_server.py, examples/, docs/mcp-local-toolkits.md and root tests/mcp. No dependency on the toolkit package; can start immediately in its own worktree.

tasks.title: Host read guards — PreToolUse policy for Claude Code and Codex (structured Read + shell subset)
tasks.parallelism_notes: M7 (hooks.py). Stdlib-only module; owns hooks.py and test_hooks.py. Only a test-time agreement check depends on TASK-3082's count_lines_bounded; safe to run in parallel with the Git/reader tasks.

tasks.title: Managed guard installation — parrot claude|codex install --tool-guards, status and owned uninstall
tasks.parallelism_notes: M7 (installation.py + core wiki CLI edits). Needs the hook module (TASK-3088) and the bounded-source config keys (TASK-3087) for threshold discovery.

tasks.title: SDD delegation workflow — templates, Claude commands, Codex skills and sdd-worker parity
tasks.parallelism_notes: M8. Single coordinated owner for sdd/templates, .claude/commands, .agents/skills and sdd-worker.md (spec Worktree Strategy). Documents the packet grammar from TASK-3083 and the generate/review/apply flow completed by TASK-3086.

tasks.title: Integration test suite — stdio protocol, raw MCP validation, Git/writer lifecycles, cross-process coordination, client configuration, host smoke
tasks.parallelism_notes: M9 (tests half). Exercises all three toolkits through parrot mcp-local; needs every product task merged.

tasks.title: Benchmark harness, baseline/optimized reports, documentation and release gate
tasks.parallelism_notes: M9 (benchmarks + docs). Last task; renders the coverage matrix and AC traceability from finished modules. Numeric targets remain an owner decision (spec §8).
